edge07_active_fade.answers: A-2 fade of a two-ATR dislocation

declared_cost_wall.note: a book at this frequency must earn more than the round-trip cost per trade, on average, before it earns anything

risk_policy: config/risk.yaml through edge01.campaign.load_risk_policy; max_trades_per_day is 20, so the frequency target is a design aim and never a reason to force an entry

criteria.statement: screen: DEV gross expectancy > 0, else REJECT_NO_GROSS_EDGE without reading the independent window
largest single trade <= 50% of the net on NEW_HOLDOUT
net > 0 in at least 2 of the 3 equal consecutive time blocks
per-asset, per-context and bootstrap readings reported, never decisive

verdicts.ADMIT_PAPER: C1-C6 all pass on NEW_HOLDOUT; admission to a paper lane only, no live trading, no capital
verdicts.REJECT: C0 failed, or a decisive criterion failed with power
verdicts.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: sample too small, or one trade carries the net, or the frequency target is missed while everything else is non-negative

consequences.on_reject: reported with its numbers, not tuned and re-run on this window
consequences.on_insufficient: reported as no result, never as a pass
